# filters.update_type

Select one or more exact native Update constructor classes through the raw event route.

## Signature

```python
def filters.update_type(*constructors: type[tl.model.TLObject]) -> Filter
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Python type | Default | Passing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `constructors` | `type[tl.model.TLObject]` | `Required` | Variadic positional |

### constructors

One or more native Update constructor classes, such as types.UpdateUserTyping. Pass classes, not instances or high-level event classes. They are validated against GramFlux's registry and combined as OR.

## Returns

Composable synchronous Filter.

## Example

```python
from gramflux import Client, Session, buttons, filters
from gramflux.raw import types

@client.on_raw_update(filters.update_type(types.UpdateUserTyping))
async def handler(event):
    print(event.update.definition.name)
```

## Constraints and failure behavior

The selector cannot enable unsupported qts/secret-chat synchronization. Raw subscriptions observe accepted Update objects; difference recovery can deliver Message objects without a synthetic Update wrapper.

These examples assume a previously constructed client where one is used. Builders and selectors do not make a network request by themselves. Invalid builder/selector inputs raise ConfigurationError or the underlying Python argument/regex error. Session I/O errors arise when storage is actually opened during connect.
